description: This file defines a wizard interface for handling point-of-sale payments in an Odoo (formerly OpenERP) module, including functions for retrieving journals, initializing payment data, adding payments, validation, and invoice creation.

classes.name: pos_payment
classes.description: Wizard interface class for POS payment processing, managing states for payment addition, validation, invoice creation, and printing.

methods.name: _get_journal
methods.description: Retrieves available cash journals for payment.

methods.name: _pre_init
methods.description: Prepares initial data for the payment wizard, including amount, journal, and date.

methods.name: _add_pay
methods.description: Adds a payment to the POS order.

methods.name: _check
methods.description: Determines the next action based on order state and payment status.

methods.name: _test_no_line
methods.description: Checks if the order has lines; raises error if none.

methods.name: create_invoice
methods.description: Creates an invoice for the order if not already invoiced.
